Pommel below the two hands; crossguard above the upper hand; long blade extends forward/up beyond the guard. Keep face, both boots, both hands and entire sword tip clearly readable.
Style/medium: beautiful hand-painted2D fantasy sprite illustration, visible controlled brush strokes, readable facial anatomy, broad graphic light/shadow masses and detailed steel/leather/cloth; NO3D render, NO photorealism, NO chibi, NO pixel mosaic. Matching restrained warm upper-left illumination and earthy low-fantasy palette. Same outfit and identity as the approved drawing.
Composition: transparent square canvas, ONE assembled character centered slightly left with free space for raised sword on upper-right. Whole figure from hair to both soles, full pommel/crossguard/blade/tip visible with generous transparent margin on ALL sides. Character body occupies roughly80percent of image height, sword tip may be slightly above head. Do not enlarge the head or boots. No additional sword or standalone objects.
Technical: genuinely transparent background with alpha. No floor, no cast shadow, scenery, annotations, title, labels, writing, decorative border, watermark, portrait inset, motion streaks or special effects.
